purpose: Complete the missing parameter and probability-quality assessment of the existing whole-menu availability experiment. No new estimation method or originality claim.
timing: Fixed before this follow-up risk fitting; the original availability experiment and its results were already inspected. This is not a preregistered study.
reuse: All 1000 existing Gaussian model cohorts, two label budgets, all three nested dimensions, every one of the 9000 original support records. No new model cohorts.
ridge_penalty: Squared Euclidean coefficient norm divided by 2m, on every fitted coordinate; no risk-based tuning.
pooling: Human labels on labelled menus plus hard predicted categories on auxiliary menus, equal menu weights. Distinct objective, no claim to preserve the human target.
power: Original fixed oracle variance power, not a high-dimensional risk optimum or learned tuning method.

numerics.retention: Every unavailable or numerically unresolved fit remains; no loss or norm truncation.

integration.method: 8 independently scrambled Sobol normal integrals with 2^11 points each; conditional Gaussian noise rotation is exact. Same nodes across all fits.
integration.independent_validation: Separate larger integral on deterministic stride and largest-norm fits, plus exact coefficient/rotation identities.

estimands: conditional expected human menu log loss
denominators: All 500 allocations per cell for availability; explicit finite numerical denominators for conditional means, medians, 95th quantiles and maxima; paired shared-fit comparisons; human-ridge fallback for unpenalized unavailable/numerically unresolved cases reported separately.
uncertainty: Paired allocation Monte Carlo errors condition on this generating law. Integration scramble errors are a separate numerical diagnostic. No interval coverage claims.
exclusions: No new questionnaires, human/LLM answers, private data, learned-predictor theorem validation, general estimator ranking or acceptance claim.
